additional_info.subject: ID0434239-DC/Si-D/DK- missing converter and dispenser warning CRM:00315002760
additional_info.body:
Dear Martin,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R5 170001811
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
U9Dn7E
Problem Description
: Several error flags
Troubleshooting
:
For the Dispenser selftestError - this error is related to:
​​​​​​​
Usually this warning is removed after a reboot.
​​​​​​​For the TF204 error - I'm not really sure why the error is triggered when we just had a normal charging session with DC4 and voltage reading looks perfectly fine:
​​​​​​​
​​​​​​​For the converter error:
​​​​​​​Since we are going to need to reboot the charger for both errors above, we can check if it works.
​​​​​​​
If the reboot doesn't work and the problem persists, we need to understand if it's a problem with the converter or the CAN cables.
For that, the easiest way it's always to swap this converter with the neighbour one (example, swap TB14 with TB15, everything - all cables and position)
If the converter with the error is still persisting, please replace the converter
If the working converter now has the CAN communication error, please check the CAN connection and see if the cables are properly attached and measure 60 Ohm between high and low.
For future reference, your case number is
0434239
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
